content.short: Render Network provides distributed GPU rendering on the blockchain.
content.description: Render Network, founded in 2016 by Jules Urbach, is a decentralized cloud-based rendering service and marketplace. It enables users to tap idle GPUs around the world to render projects more quickly and at a lower cost than in-house rendering. Developers can earn RNDR tokens by registering their idle GPUs on the network. The Ethereum-based platform hosts artists' creations and provides full digital rights management, ensuring secure storage and rights control across the ecosystem.
